note: Top-level application navigation bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: Mail, Address Book, Calendar, Tasks, Chat, Settings, Collapse
Unified toolbar and window controls -- renders: search icon, app menu, minimize, restore, close; search entry text is user input and subtracted
Application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: File, Edit, View, Go, Message, Tasks, Help
Chat toolbar controls -- renders: Add Buddy, Join Chat, Status, Accounts; status message label is operator-defined status text
Folder pane header controls -- renders: More, Write Message, Get Messages
Thread pane header controls -- renders: Quick Filter, Display; folder name and count are user-defined and subtracted
Quick filter bar controls -- renders: Sticky, Unread, Starred, In Address Book, Tags, Attachment, Sender, Recipients, Subject, Body; search text and result count are dynamic and subtracted
Status bar -- renders: Offline status, status text (operator-defined application state)
Thunderbird start page -- renders: Release Channel, Donate, Logo, Tagline, Features, Get Started; all content is operator-authored marketing and onboarding copy
